name: Paleontology Minor
intro: Paleontology is a science that fascinates people from all walks of life. Many who plan careers in other disciplines harbor a strong desire to learn significantly more about paleontology during their college years. This minor is intended to provide the necessary foundational learning in biology and geology together with an emphasis on the evolution and extinction of life over deep geological time.
